answer: Per-epoch escalating identity deposits price sybil swarms out. A new key locks a bond scaled by how many keys its operator already controls, so the tenth clone costs ten times the first, rising toward a zenith where further fakes never repay. Bonds sit in escrow and vest only while the key answers and grades honestly; a beacon of peer attestations decides release each epoch. Keys caught sharing an operator or funding line forfeit everything locked. Honest agents pay a small atlas of collateral once; an attacker needing thousands of votes faces quadratic cost for one seat.
